KvItem.description: A key and its value. Keys/values that are not valid UTF-8 in utf8 mode are returned in `key_b64` / `value_b64`. Values stored as blobs larger than the inline JSON limit only carry `blob`.

Op.description: One operation. Keys and values are UTF-8 strings unless the request sets `encoding: base64`.

OpResult.description: Result of one op; the fields present depend on the op (see Op).

Query.description: Scan the primary key (default) or a secondary index: equality on a prefix of its columns (`eq`), an optional range on the next column, a residual filter, and pagination via `cursor`.

Row.description: Column name to value. `bytes` are base64; `blob` columns take a staged `blob_id` on write and return BlobMeta on read.

info.description: Transactional key-value and table databases on object storage. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <session token or API key>` (or the `brs_session` cookie). Errors use the Error schema with a stable `code`; `retryable` errors may be retried (use idempotency keys for writes).
info.title: Baserunna

post.description: Keys may be limited to one database (`db`) and/or be read-only. Requires a session.

201.description: The full key is shown only once

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

post.description: Subject to the server's sign-up policy. The first account becomes an administrator.

201.description: Signed up; a session is returned and set as a cookie

delete.description: Immediately invisible everywhere; storage is purged after a grace period. The name can be reused at once.

201.description: Staged; bind it with a put op (blob_id) or a blob column within an hour

get.description: Fences in-flight attempts first, so the answer is final for commits whose request has ended (wait at least the commit deadline, about 15 s, after an ambiguous failure).

post.description: Ops execute in order with read-your-writes, atomically. Serializable by default; conflicts are retried server-side. With `idempotency_key`, retries never apply twice (a replay returns `replayed: true` and null results).
